detail.longDescription: I've been building a small database: LuraDB. Key-value, JSON documents and slim relational tables in one process on io_uring. Everything speaks REST, down to the single record: no driver, curl is enough. A built-in MCP server gives AI agents the same data and permissions. Written in Rust, Linux-first, ships as a .deb. Source on GitHub, each release becomes Apache 2.0 two years after it ships. https:// luradb.org # Rust # Linux # Database # io_uring # MCP # FairSource # SelfHosted
